company_name: Zhejiang Morita New Materials Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides essential etching and cleaning materials for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Zhejiang Morita New Materials Co., Ltd. specializes in producing microelectronic etching and cleaning grade materials critical for semiconductor and microelectronics processing. As a Sino-Japanese joint venture, the company leverages extensive expertise in fluorochemistry to support integrated circuit manufacturing.
capabilities: Cleaning grade materials for semiconductor processing

regional_presence.China: The company is based in China and operates as a joint venture with Morita Chemical Industries, Ltd.
